goals.name: Connection Cadence — quarterly regional outing + mover-manager roundtables (bundles the 5 eNPS asks)
goals.assessment: Two halves to this rock and the manager-roundtable half just moved. The first manager strategy meeting of the quarter is set for Thursday 9/3, 2:30-3:45, all 10 branch managers across both regions, and the agenda has been redesigned rather than repeated — a pair-first format where managers brief each other in pairs, then each presents their partner's notes to the room, with leadership split into two leads and two silent observers. It is built directly against the failure mode these sessions have had: managers vocal offline and silent in the room, handing problems up instead of solving them. Blueprint is published and the plan is posted to the rock pulse; two format calls are still with Mike and Cameron. On the events half, budget is closed at $75 per person and options and candidate dates are compiled across 5 regions and 37 attendees, but no region has voted and no date is locked yet.
blockers: 9/3 session format not yet confirmed by Mike and Cameron — two open calls: five minutes per presenter or four, and whether pair-first is the format we run
No regional event dates locked — the choice pulse per region still has not gone out, and that is the step that turns a list into a scheduled date
Second BM roundtable not scheduled; green needs 2 conducted with manager feedback and action items

goals.name: CTXH Quarterly Theme Mgmt — Ensure All Managers Hit QGs
goals.assessment: Both hard deadlines were met. Manager sandbox training finished 15 of 15 — Daniel B., Nick D., Jespah L. and Joel V. closed out on the 8/19 deadline, and Sergio Buenrostro completed 8/24 on his documented extended timeline (approved PTO predating the deadline). 100% of active movers were enrolled in the training app on 8/20 as planned. That clears two of the three green conditions. The whole rock now rests on the third: the adoption floor of ≥70% of enrolled movers through stage 4 by EOQ. That is a 10-week behavior problem, not a deadline problem, and it has not started — which is why confidence stays at 4 rather than rising with the percentage. Note the rock is training-camp completion and adoption, not general QG accountability.
blockers: Adoption floor — ≥70% of enrolled movers through stage 4 by EOQ — not started; this is now the entire risk on the rock

goals.name: Scrum Accountability Part 3 — Huddle Grading + Value Tracking
goals.assessment: Rollout shipped 8/24 — all 15 managers have their board and the announcement is on the Delegation Board. Two managers are certified: Calvin Hughes 52/60 and Joel Villatoro 54/60 after same-day rework, both re-scored under rubric v1.5. Twelve boards remain. Deadline extended 8/27 from Thursday 8/27 to Monday 8/31 — v1.5 landed mid-cohort on 8/26 and forced the re-score of the first two certs, so holding the rest to Thursday would have graded them against a bar that moved under them. Also corrected a live error in the manager announcement: the last two categories were labeled Bonus when v1.5 makes them 5 points each, 10 of the 60 — anyone who skipped them could not have cleared the 51-point line. A defect was found in the certification quiz — two Paragraph-type questions Google Forms cannot auto-grade, holding 2 of 10 points at zero. The 7 responses received were hand-graded 8/27; the underlying question-type fix is still open.
blockers: Certification quiz still cannot auto-score two questions — the DLOW/WLOW and deferred-Monday questions are Paragraph type, which Google Forms cannot grade. The 7 existing responses were hand-graded 8/27 so nothing is lost, but every future taker is capped at 8/10 until the question types change or the two are set to 0 points
12 of 14 manager boards still outstanding, now due Monday 8/31
Deadline has already moved once; a second slip would put recertification inside the EOQ window
